name: Nixarchy Hyprland Settings
author: Aziz
description: Nixarchy Hyprland Settings (based on Hyprforge by Aziz / AbdulazizAlwabel): a Hyprland studio for Omarchy: live-previewed gaps, borders, theme-palette colors, corners, opacity, blur, shadow, glow, animations with a bezier/spring curve editor, layouts, input, cursor, gestures, per-app rules, profiles, history and every Hyprland option. Open with SUPER+SPACE › Nixarchy Hyprland Settings or `omarchy-shell hyprforge toggle`.
